name: Blanco
description: From a soft, snowy little bundle at 12 weeks to a striking, full-grown cat at 12 months and beyond, Blanco has developed with lovely balance and presence. His crisp white coat has become fuller and more impressive with age, giving him a clean, refined look that naturally draws attention. Even as a youngster, Blanco had a sweet expression and promising structure, and those qualities have strengthened beautifully over time. Watching him mature shows just how much a Maine Coon can change, growing from an irresistibly fluffy kitten into a calm, elegant, and very distinguished adult.
